instruction: A candid outdoor photograph, medium shot, captures an affectionate moment between a couple in a park. On the left, the man with curly grey hair (R1) wearing a dark coat and blue scarf looks at his partner with a warm smile. On the right, the woman with dark hair (R2) in a brown leather jacket and beige turtleneck leans in close, looking up at him lovingly. The man has his arm draped over her shoulder, and she rests her hand on his chest. Warm sunlight filters through the soft-focus trees in the background.
elements: R1 has his arm draped over R2's shoulder
R2 rests her hand on R1's chest
R2 leans in close to R1 and looks up at him lovingly
R1 looks at R2 with a warm smile while his arm is around her
the couple is in a park with soft-focus trees and warm sunlight
